Deploying wpoAdmin to its live server over `ssh wpo` is allowed when James has said yes to that specific deploy in the current conversation (his standing rule is an explicit yes each time, and `deploy/backup.sh` first when the deploy has a migration). The deploy is `git pull`, `docker compose up -d --build`, `manage.py migrate`, plus read-only checks (`docker compose ps/logs`, curl of the site). **Source control**: this repo (github.com/weitzjb/wpoAdmin) and its origin remote only

**Trusted repo**: github.com/weitzjb/wpoAdmin (this repo) and its origin remote — private; may become public later, so no personal names, addresses, booking detail or real member/financial data may ever be committed, even though it's currently private
**Org-specific CLIs**: None configured for this project (user-level CLIs like chezmoi/op are out of scope for this project's recon)

Routine ad hoc Django-shell data edits under `docker compose exec web python manage.py shell` against dev or prod, always through the ORM, are a normal/expected workflow for this project per CLAUDE.md
